preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 1000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'impossible' if len(set(s)) < k else stdout == str(min_changes)
postconditions.description: If the number of unique letters in s is less than k, output 'impossible'; otherwise, output the minimum number of changes needed.

postconditions.expression: min_changes == k - len(set(s)) if k <= len(s) else 'impossible'
postconditions.description: The minimum number of changes is the difference between k and the number of unique letters in s, if possible.
